# cachefly_edge_control_script_versions (Data Source)

Lists all published versions of the edge control script of a service for one kind, newest first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cachefly_edge_control_script_versions" "request" {
  service_id = "681b3dc52715310035cb75d4"
  kind       = "REQUEST"
}

output "published_versions" {
  value = [for v in data.cachefly_edge_control_script_versions.request.versions : "${v.version}: ${v.status}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Kind of script: `REQUEST` or `RESPONSE`.
- `service_id` (String) ID of the service.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in the form `service_id:kind`.
- `versions` (Attributes List) Published versions, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the version was published.
- `filename` (String) Name of the file the version is stored as.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the version.
- `last_activated_at` (String) When the version was last activated.
- `script` (String) JavaScript source of the version.
- `script_size` (Number) Size of the script in bytes.
- `status` (String) Status of the version (ACTIVE or DEACTIVATED).
- `version` (Number) Version number.
